description: This file defines an abstract class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_Composite that extends HTMLPurifier_Strategy, representing a composite strategy pattern for HTML token processing. It manages a list of strategies and applies them sequentially to tokens.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_Composite
classes.description: An abstract class implementing a composite strategy pattern, executes multiple token processing strategies on HTML tokens.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs all strategies in sequence on the given tokens, config, and context, returning the processed tokens.
